method: Independent full-prose/source review of actual new 2.3 model calls. Source facts for EPCM and well are added only when explicitly present; all other full source inputs retained, no model calls or DB writes by the review; contracts are controls, not market accuracy.

checks.future_well_fact: Final summary井已计划永久封堵 means a plan exists, not that plugging or abandonment has physically finished; it explicitly retains the source future action and satisfies the dedicated control. No已弃置/已完成封井 occurs.
checks.supply_direction: Gas/condensate resource discovery offers future supply potential without current production or delivered gas. Flat/weak net news pressure is defensible; no resource barrels are treated as current physical gas supply.
checks.price_anchor: Target21Oct needs20Oct same-contract reference, which is missing;19Oct88.04 is not yesterday. Absolute86.585 quote is not turned into a−1.45 closing direction. Close is insufficient/null rather than a default flat forecast.
checks.pricing: Announcement reaction is explicitly unconfirmed, not未计价. No single quote is treated as a causal announcement response.
checks.snapshot_time: Original19Oct article is known earlier-window background; supplementary excerpt is known by fixed asof. No future price/event outcome is introduced.
checks.causal_scope: 发现未导致即时供给变化 and 新闻未产生即时供需冲击 are interpreted as direct source-news transmission judgements for a non-producing discovery; they are not observed zero total European flows or a no-price-reaction assertion.
checks.actual_generation: One new real call returned a correct result. Input/system/schema are unchanged by the final validator-only fix; this observation does not prove a deterministic effect of that gate on first-call generation.

qualifications: 已计划永久封堵 is explicit planned action; better source-aligned prose would be原报道说该井将永久封堵并弃井. It does not assert completed plugging.
This case contains no current-window Troll notices, so it does not replace the separate fresh production-flow review of facility type and interval capacity arithmetic.
Previous b1 failed attempts and the failed detailed control remain preserved and are not converted to successes.
